title: War beasts, concept round WB2 (D-127): a war boar, a tarantula alone, new beasts for frogs and beetles; the elephant kept
_doc: Dominic on WB1: 'we're focusing on capybara too much, doesn't really fit. Boar is better but maybe too small. Spider riding a spider seems pointless, better just a tarantula.' Size references: a worker, a pony rider (romans large), a spider rider (spooky spiders large). Models: scenes/art_pixel/m13_concepts.gd (WB2), staged from data/later/m13_concepts.json.
